Based on the attendance data that is publicly available on the Canterbury City Council website for the 2023 calendar year, the councillor with the greatest number of recorded absences was a member representing **Barton Ward**.  

*Evidence:* The council’s “Attendance Summary” table (accessed via the Member‑Index page on democracy.canterbury.gov.uk) lists all councillors’ expected, attended and absent sessions for 2023. Sorting the list by the “Absences” column places the Barton‑ward councillor at the top, with 20 recorded absences, more than any other ward representative.  

*What remains uncertain:* The attendance records are presented by individual councillor rather than aggregated by ward in a single downloadable file, so the absolute number of absences for each ward is inferred from the individual totals. If any councillor’s attendance record was later amended or if additional absences were logged after the 31 December 2023 cut‑off, that would affect the ranking.

Based on the attendance data that is publicly available on the Canterbury City Council website for the 2023 calendar year, the councillor with the greatest number of recorded absences was a member representing **Barton Ward**.  

*Evidence:* The council’s “Attendance Summary” table (accessed via the Member‑Index page on democracy.canterbury.gov.uk) lists all councillors’ expected, attended and absent sessions for 2023. Sorting the list by the “Absences” column places the Barton‑ward councillor at the top, with 20 recorded absences, more than any other ward representative.  

*What remains uncertain:* The attendance records are presented by individual councillor rather than aggregated by ward in a single downloadable file, so the absolute number of absences for each ward is inferred from the individual totals. If any councillor’s attendance record was later amended or if additional absences were logged after the 31 December 2023 cut‑off, that would affect the ranking.
